samples.title: Public Prostate158 MONAI-inferred demo
samples.source: Prostate158 T2W (Adams et al. 2022) + MONAI prostate_mri_anatomy bundle 0.3.6
samples.notes: MONAI prostate_mri_anatomy bundle inference on a real Prostate158 T2W. The bundle outputs central gland + peripheral zone; no lesion class. Volumes are geometric from the bundle's output. Published Dice on Prostate158 test set: central gland 0.877, PZ 0.754. Not clinically validated in this app.
samples.disclaimer: Inference output, not clinically validated. Single-case sanity check only.
samples.known_issue: Input T2W in this session came from an nnU-Net preprocessed .npy with reconstructed metadata, so the output is spatially shifted ~28 mm from the underlying anatomy. See comparison_report.md. Re-run with the raw T2W from the Zenodo archive to fix.
